name: SIDAPRO FSB UNG
desc: Application that can manage the administrative process for students and lecturers regarding the submission of thesis titles to the judiciary.

impact.purpose: Take the thesis paperwork at FSB UNG, from title submission to the judiciary, off paper for students, lecturers and staff.

saving.label: less admin time for study-program staff

changes.before: Title proposals handed in on paper
Students chasing lecturers for signatures
Progress tracked by asking around
changes.after: Status visible to students and staff

changes.before: Judiciary lists recapped by hand
Records filed in folders

name: GoVillage
desc: Application designed to digitize village administration and public services to enhance efficiency and accessibility for rural communities.

impact.purpose: Move village administration and public services online, so residents get letters and information without repeated trips to the village office.

saving.label: less time to issue a village letter

changes.before: Visiting the office to request a letter
Letters typed from scratch each time
Resident records kept on paper
No way to know where a request stands
Announcements on the notice board only

name: SINERGI
desc: Application that facilitates regional development planning through Working Paper (Kertas Kerja) features with real-time SIPD integration.

name: SIH3
desc: Integrated platform for Hydrology, Hydrogeology, and Hydrometeorology Information System (SIH3) that facilitates water resource data management in collaboration with PUPR, River Basin Organization, and BMKG.

name: E-Commerce Kotamobagu
desc: E-commerce platform specifically designed for Kotamobagu city to empower local MSMEs and facilitate digital transactions for regional products.

name: Dinul Islam - Digital Lettering
desc: Digital lettering application designed to streamline administrative correspondence and document management for the Dinul Islam program at Universitas Muhammadiyah Gorontalo.

name: GRHM
desc: Gerakan Rakyati Hulonthalo Mosikola: the province-wide new-student admission (SPMB) system for every public SMA and SMK in Gorontalo, with Dapodik sync, zoning maps and real-time announcements.

gallery.caption: Live registrant distribution across 112 schools and 26,312 seats

impact.purpose: Replace school-by-school paper registration with one provincial system, so every applicant applies once, schools verify online and placement follows zoning and quotas openly.

saving.label: less admin work for school admission committees

changes.before: Queuing at each school with paper files
changes.after: One online account with NIK and NISN, from anywhere

changes.before: Documents checked by hand at the counter
changes.after: Uploads verified online by the school team

changes.before: Distance to school measured by hand
changes.after: Zoning map with domicile check built in

changes.before: Quota recaps in each school's spreadsheet
Results pinned on notice boards
Student data typed in again

name: E-Sign Gorontalo
desc: Electronic signature platform for the Gorontalo provincial government: sequential approval workflows, bulk signing, chunked PDF upload and a public API so other government apps can sign through SSO, with signatures backed by BSrE (BSSN) electronic certificates.

gallery.caption: Feature tour, from submission to public API

impact.purpose: Let provincial offices draft, approve and sign official documents without printing them and carrying them from desk to desk.

changes.before: Printed drafts carried between offices for initials
Letter numbers taken from a manual register
Signing stacks of letters one by one
Calling the issuer to confirm a document
changes.after: Public PDF verification with a BSrE certificate

changes.before: Each app handling signatures on its own
Paper, printing and courier costs
changes.after: Documents stay digital end to end

name: Webuild
desc: Multi-tenant web builder that runs every OPD's public website from one platform: one hostname per unit, themeable section builder, strict per-app data isolation and server-rendered pages for SEO.

gallery.caption: Catalog of 46 OPD apps and portals
Built on Webuild: Museum Purbakala, with online visit booking

impact.purpose: Run every OPD's public website from one platform instead of each office building, hosting and maintaining its own.

saving.label: less effort to launch and maintain an OPD website

changes.before: Each office commissions its own website
changes.after: A new site is a new tenant with a theme

changes.before: Dozens of separate servers and CMS versions
changes.after: One codebase; one update reaches every site

changes.before: Layouts and quality differ per office
changes.after: Standard sections, accessibility tools and provincial branding

changes.before: Security patches applied site by site
changes.after: Patched once, with data isolated per app

changes.before: Content changes wait for a developer
changes.after: Staff edit pages in the section builder

changes.before: Services scattered and hard to find
changes.after: One catalog and search across OPD portals

name: DK Mart Marketplace
desc: Online minimarket for retail and wholesale shopping across DK Mart's three Gorontalo branches: stock synced in real time with each store, delivery from the nearest branch, QRIS, virtual account and e-wallet payments, and business accounts with Net-30 invoices.

gallery.caption: Storefront for the DK Mart Telaga branch
Best sellers with prices per unit
Product page with retail and wholesale units
Wholesale catalog: 7,210 products in bulk units

impact.purpose: Let households and shop owners buy from DK Mart's branches online, with wholesale pricing for businesses.

saving.label: less staff time taking orders and checking stock

changes.before: Orders taken by phone and WhatsApp
Asking staff whether an item is in stock
Wholesale prices quoted by hand
changes.after: Bulk units and prices built into every product

changes.before: Cash on delivery only
changes.after: QRIS, virtual account and e-wallet payments

changes.before: Handwritten notes for business buyers
Calling the store to ask about an order
changes.after: Order tracking from processing to delivery
